title: Mesh-aware tetrahedron cylinder coverage and exact area budgets
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; one separately tasked AI reviewer. Not human peer review.
claim: For the source parabolic secant-axis construction, arbitrary finite partitions of maximum gap D cover the closed regular tetrahedron when 2eta-(7/4+2eta)tau-D/(4tau)-D/4>=0. The normalized area error is at most 59tau^4/64+tau^2 D.
assumptions: 0<tau<1, eta>=0 for coverage; eta<=1/8 for the area estimate.
A shared finite strictly increasing partition of [-1,1], the specified secant axes and constant per-sector cutoffs.
Continuum coverage and analytic inequalities are written proofs, not formally verified.

concrete_instance.comparison: Reduces the original source example from 16,000,000 cylinders; much weaker than Pinho’s existing 4096-cylinder cover.

verification.independent_area_check: Exact polynomial sector-sum enclosure over all one million sectors, without the main integral approximation; shared SymPy dependency.
verification.geometry_control: Actual uncovered rational point without enlargement, independently checked by barycentric linear systems.
verification.reproduce: Install requirements-dev.txt, then run python reproduce.py in the pinned packet.

predecessors: OpenAI construction, first-crossing proof, radial identity, normalization and Taylor/integral area method.
limitations: Not a record, an optimality result or an established globally novel mechanism.
A negative sufficient budget does not prove a cover fails.
The source coverage theorem already has a continuum proof; this is not a claim that it had a gap.

upstream_review.review_scope: Clean rerun, source hash checks, separate symbolic/rational checks and stepwise written-proof inspection by Pico (AI). Not human peer review or kernel verification.
